metas.name: Tampopo
metas.description:
Food is craft, sex, comedy and social ritual all at once. A truck driver mentors a widow until her ramen is perfect, cut with vignettes of people eating in every possible way.

A truck driver stops at a small family-run noodle shop and decides to help its fledgling business. The story is intertwined with various vignettes about the relationship of love and food.

metas.name: There Will Be Blood
metas.description:
Acquisition becomes a religion with one worshipper. An oil prospector buys land, builds derricks, adopts a son as a prop, spars with a preacher, and hollows out in proportion to his success.

A story of family, religion, hatred, oil and madness, focusing on a turn-of-the-century prospector in the early days of the business.

metas.name: Unforgiven
metas.description:
The western myth is dragged back by an old killer who is bad at everything now. Retired, broke and widowed, he cannot mount his horse or shoot straight, and the film insists killing is exactly as ugly as that implies.

Retired Old West gunslinger Will Munny reluctantly takes on one last job to avenge an injustice with the help of his old partner and a young would-be gunman calling himself "The Schofield Kid".

metas.name: The Assassination of Jesse James by the Coward Robert Ford
metas.description:
Celebrity worship, 1882 style, drives this film. A famous outlaw ageing and paranoid, and a young admirer who memorised his life from dime novels and moves into his orbit — slow, golden, narrated like a history book.

Robert Ford, who has idolized Jesse James since childhood, tries hard to join the resurgent gang of the Missouri outlaw, but gradually becomes resentful of the bandit leader.

metas.name: Meek's Cutoff
metas.description:
Being lost is shown from the women's side of the wagons. Oregon Trail settlers, a guide who may be bluffing, water running out — long shots of bonnets and horizon where the drama is thirst and waiting.

Settlers traveling through the Oregon desert in 1845 find themselves stranded in harsh conditions.

metas.name: Brokeback Mountain
metas.description:
Some love affairs are conducted in a few weeks a year, across twenty years. Wyoming herders, marriages and children in between, and a shirt kept in a closet doing more work than any speech.

Two shepherds fall for each other, but their relationship becomes complicated when they both get married to their respective girlfriends.

metas.name: Hell or High Water
metas.description:
Two brothers rob the bank that is taking their family's land. West Texas, foreclosed ranches and debt-relief billboards, and two ageing Rangers following them at the speed of talk — a western wearing a recession.

A divorced father and his ex-con brother plan a series of heists against the bank that's about to foreclose on their family ranch.

metas.name: A Girl Walks Home Alone at Night
metas.description:
A vampire film gets rebuilt from Iranian, Western and skate-punk parts. A fictional Iranian ghost town, a chador-wearing vampire on a skateboard, a drug dealer and a cat, in long black-and-white silences between bursts of pop.

In the Iranian ghost-town Bad City, a place that reeks of death and loneliness, the townspeople are unaware they are being stalked by a lonesome vampire.

metas.name: Lucky
metas.description:
A 90-year-old atheist's daily routine adds up to a complete philosophy: yoga, crosswords, a missing tortoise named President Roosevelt, the same bar, the same stool. Harry Dean Stanton's final role — old age as appetite and community rather than decline, in a desert town that has made room for him exactly as he is.

Lucky follows the spiritual journey of a 90-year-old atheist and the quirky characters that inhabit his off the map desert town.
